I need to stay in my lane here. That's a question for a doctor or dietitian — how alcohol and pre-workout interact with each other and your body is their call, not mine.

What I can tell you on the training side: alcohol tanks recovery and performance the next day, and pre-workout is built to push you hard. If you're using pre-workout, you want sleep and food on your side. Alcohol works against both. So from a training standpoint, the timing matters.

What are you working toward this week?
